data.name: Tasawur
data.long_meaning: A person who can visualize and imagine things in their mind, can form and shape their thoughts and ideas.
data.spiritual_meaning: A person who can see beyond the physical world and can connect with the divine through their imagination and creativity.

in_arabic.name: تصور
in_arabic.meaning: التصور هو التفكير أو التخيل أو تصوير شيء في الذهن
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم تصور مشتق من الفعل 'صَوَرَ' الذي يعني تصوير أو تشكيل صورة في الذهن. في اللغة العربية، يعني التفكير أو التخيل أو تصوير شيء في الذهن. وفي الاصطلاح الإسلامي، قد يرتبط بالتفكير العميق والتأمل في خلق الله والكون.

in_urdu.name: تصور
in_urdu.meaning: تصور کا مطلب ہے سوچنا، تخیل کرنا یا ذہن میں تصویر بنانا
in_urdu.long_meaning: تصور نام کا مطلب ہے کسی چیز کو ذہن میں تصور کرنا یا اس کا چিত্র کھینچنا۔ یہ نام عربی زبان کے الفعل 'صَوَرَ' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کے معنی ہیں تصویر کرنا یا بنانا۔ اسلامی ثقافت میں، یہ گہری سوچ اور غور و خوض کی علامت ہے، خاص طور پر اللہ کی قدرت اور مخلوقات کے بارے میں۔

in_hindi.name: तसवुर
in_hindi.meaning: तसवुर का अर्थ है सोचना, कल्पना करना या मन में चित्र बनाना
in_hindi.long_meaning: तसवुर नाम का अर्थ है मन में किसी वस्तु की कल्पना करना या उसकी तस्वीर बनाना। यह नाम अरबी भाषा के क्रिया 'صَوَرَ' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है चित्रण या बनाना। भारतीय मुस्लिम परंपरा में, यह गहरी सोच और आत्म-संवाद की निशानी है, विशेष रूप से अल्लाह की शक्ति और सृष्टि के बारे में।

in_pashto.name: تصور
in_pashto.meaning: تصور معنی یې فکر کول، تصور کول یا په ذهن کې انځور جوړول
in_pashto.long_meaning: تصور نوم دا پدې معنی ده چې په ذهن کې یو څه انځور کړئ یا یې نقشه جوړه کړئ. دا نوم د عربي ژبې د فعل 'صَوَرَ' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، کوم چې د انځور کولو یا جوړولو معنی لري. په افغان او پښتون دود کې، دا د ژور فکر او د الله تعالی د قدرت او مخلوقاتو په اړه د غور او خوض نښه ده.

in_english.name: Tasawur
in_english.meaning: Tasawur means thinking, imagining, or picturing something in the mind
in_english.long_meaning: The name Tasawur originates from the Arabic verb 'صَوَرَ' (sawara), which means to picture, imagine, or create an image. In Islamic tradition, Tasawur signifies deep contemplation and reflection, particularly on the power and creations of Allah. Historically, it has been used to describe the act of mental imagery and thoughtful consideration. The name carries spiritual significance, symbolizing introspection and mental visualization.

data.cultural_impact: In the Islamic context, Tasawur refers to the ability to imagine and visualize things in the mind. This concept is significant in various aspects of Islamic life, including art, literature, and education. Islamic art is known for its intricate designs and patterns, which are often the result of deep contemplation and meticulous planning. Tasawur is also emphasized in the process of learning the Quran by heart, where memorization involves not just the rote memorization of words, but also the formation of mental images and understanding of the text's meaning.
data.spiritual_significance: Tasawur holds a deep spiritual significance in Islamic tradition as it is believed to be a means of connecting with the divine. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "Verily, the erudite scholar is not the one who has read many books, but the one who has comprehended them (an 'arif)." Comprehension and understanding of spiritual truths come not just through listening or reading, but also through the ability to visualize and contemplate. The Quran itself is a source of spiritual inspiration, and the act of visualizing its verses and stories in the mind can deepen one's connection to Allah and His message. Furthermore, Tasawur is believed to play a role in the process of spiritual growth and personal development, as one's thoughts and ideas shape their character and actions.
